text:
nora: Opening a tiny playbook PR to tidy up guidance for function/tool calling + structured output. Goals: short migration checklist for teams moving off regex, minimal py/ts SDK snippets, a few guardrails, and two anchor fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1799 :sparkles:
liam: love it. can you include a one-paragraph "quick decision" section: when to enforce schema vs when to accept free-form text? customers ask this a lot
ada: small heads-up: call out key naming differences early (python: structured_output, js/ts: structuredOutput). we've had confusion in examples where casing mixed and users pasted code that didn't run
carmen: also add a tiny section on streaming: when stream=true you can get partial JSON; recommend buffer_full_response=true or stream=false for strict validation. add a link to runtime issue tracker for context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/432
nora: will add a one-paragraph decision heuristic and highlight key casing. drafting micro-snippets here (kept intentionally short):
```python
# python SDK minimal: function/tool call with json schema
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
r = c.call_tool(
    name="invoice_totals",
    input={"text": "..."},
    structured_output={
        "type": "json_schema",
        "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"total": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["total"]}
    }
)
# check r.output or r.errors
```
```ts
// typescript minimal: camelCase SDK
import { RedClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedClient()
const res = await client.callTool({
  name: 'invoice_totals',
  input: { text: '...' },
  structuredOutput: { type: 'json_schema', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { total: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['total'] } }
})
// res.output or res.errors
```
liam: can you add one tiny fallback example (retry once then fallback to text parse)? helps support callers decide quickly
nora: adding one-liner for fallback: `if res.errors: retry_once(); else: use(res.output); if still errors: fallback_to_text_parser()`
ada: for guardrails suggest bullet points: - keep required fields minimal - avoid overly loose types for critical fields - prefer explicit number types for amounts - run in warn mode for 24-72h before enforcing
carmen: and update the two old anchors that 404: replace `/docs/tooling/call` -> `/docs/tool-calling/` and `/docs/structured-output/#jsonschema` -> `/docs/structured-output/#json-schema`. call out in PR description so release notes pick it up
